The '''Greased Wheel''' was the name of a black market trade ring during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The trade ring had exclusive access to some valuable goods and trade routes in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Breaking In}}</ref>
